title: CoreApiDocumentField
description: One extracted field of a document. `value` is the typed value (money in minor units, an ISO date) or null for a text field or one that did not parse. `line` is the 1-based line of `lines` holding the span start, null when the span lies outside the stored text. `verified` is true only when the quote equals the stored text at its span, a money or date field parsed, and the confidence meets the threshold or the extraction was confirmed.
